name: Zolo Accordion
author: bdthemes

sections.description:
The Accordion Gutenberg Blocks WordPress Plugin is a lightweight, user-friendly, and highly customizable plugin designed to help you create beautiful accordions for your WordPress website using the Gutenberg block editor. Whether you’re building FAQs, product descriptions, or any other collapsible content, this plugin provides an intuitive way to organize and display information in a clean, responsive, and interactive manner.

With this plugin, you can easily add accordions to your posts, pages, or custom post types without writing a single line of code. It seamlessly integrates with the Gutenberg editor, allowing you to create and manage accordions with just a few clicks. The plugin is fully responsive, ensuring your accordions look great on all devices, from desktops to mobile phones.

🔑 Key Features

  • 🎛️ Easy-to-use Accordion Block for Gutenberg
  • ➕ Add multiple accordions inside a single block
  • 📌 Toggle or accordion mode (one open at a time)
  • 🎨 Icon customization (position, icon type, size)
  • ✏️ Typography, color, and spacing control
  • 📱 Fully responsive layout & mobile optimized
  • ⚡ Smooth expand/collapse animations
  • 🔄 Supports nested blocks inside accordion content
  • 💡 RTL & accessibility (ARIA) support
  • 🔌 Lightweight and fast-loading
sections.installation:
Plugin Installation Method:

  1. Go to the WordPress dashboard
  2. Got to the Plugins > Add New
  3. Type “Accordion” in the search box
  4. Click on “Install” button
  5. After install the plugin Activate the plugin

Installation via Zip file:

  1. Download Accordion block plugin zip file from WordPress
  2. Go to site Dashboard > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugins
  3. Select the Accordion zip file and proceed to install
  4. Activate Accordion.
sections.faq:
How to Use?

  1. Add the Accordion Block:

    • Open the WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg).
    • Click the “+” button to add a new block.
    • Search for “Accordion” and select it from the block library.

  2. Add Content to the Accordion:

    • Type your header text directly into the accordion title.
    • Add your desired content (text, images, or other blocks) inside the collapsible section.

  3. Customize the Accordion:

    • Toggle Settings: Use the block settings sidebar to customize the accordion:
      • Choose whether the accordion starts open or closed.
      • Enable or disable multiple sections being open at once.
    • Style Options:
      • Adjust font size, background color, and padding.
      • Add icons for the expand/collapse toggle.

  4. Preview Your Accordion:

    • Use the “Preview” option in the editor to see how your accordion looks on the front end.

  5. Save and Publish:

    • Save your changes and publish the post or page to make the accordion visible on your site.

Is this plugin compatible with my theme?

Yes, the Accordion Gutenberg Blocks plugin is designed to work with all modern WordPress themes. However, if you encounter any issues, please ensure your theme supports Gutenberg blocks.

Can I use multiple accordions on a single page?

Absolutely! You can add as many accordion blocks as you need on a single page or post.

Is the plugin translation-ready?

Yes, the plugin is translation-ready and supports multilingual websites. You can use translation plugins like WPML or Loco Translate to translate the accordion content.

Does the plugin support custom CSS?

Yes, you can add custom CSS to further style your accordions. Use the “Additional CSS” section in the WordPress Customizer or your theme’s stylesheet.

Is the plugin optimized for performance?

Yes, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for fast loading times. It does not include any unnecessary scripts or styles that could slow down your website.

Can I use custom icons for the accordion toggle buttons?

Yes, the plugin allows you to choose from a variety of built-in icons or upload your own custom icons.

Is the plugin accessible for screen readers?

Yes, the plugin is designed with accessibility in mind. It includes ARIA attributes and supports keyboard navigation for improved accessibility.

Do I need any page builder (such as Elementor/Divi) to use it?

No. With this plugin, you will actually replace all popular page builder plugins. On top of that, you can enjoy a similar yet faster and more robust customization experience in the Gutenberg environment.

  2. Run npm install to install dependencies.
  3. Run npm run build to compile the plugin.
